svg.title: AgentRecall architecture: local and hosted modes share one core
svg.desc: Local mode: the ar CLI with hooks, the SDK, and agent-recall-mcp over stdio write to ~/.agent-recall on your disk. Hosted mode: agents reach Caddy (deploy/hosted) over HTTPS, then agent-recall-server (packages/mcp-server/src/http) with OAuth, tokens and limits. Both MCP entry points build their server with build-server.ts, and everything runs on agent-recall-core. Hosted memory is stored in one folder per user under DATA/tenants.
